stories.title: HMRC Q1 2026–27 Performance Update: 350 Criminal Investigators Recruited
stories.summary: HMRC has published its first quarterly performance update for 2026–27, highlighting the recruitment of 350 criminal investigators to tackle tax evasion by small businesses, following the Chancellor's Budget 2025 announcement.

stories.title: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax: Service Availability Update
stories.summary: HMRC updated its Making Tax Digital for Income Tax service availability and issues page on 13 August 2026, providing latest status on the software submission service for income tax updates.

stories.title: Asylum Hotels Handed Back to Communities as Government Cuts Temporary Accommodation
stories.summary: The Home Office has returned more former asylum hotels to local communities, ready to reopen for tourists and businesses, as the government continues to reduce its reliance on hotel-based asylum accommodation.

stories.title: Monthly Entry Clearance Visa Applications: July 2026 Statistics Published
stories.summary: The Home Office has released monthly visa application statistics for July 2026, covering entry clearance data following major immigration policy changes announced in the May 2025 white paper.

stories.title: Gig Fans Urged to 'Stop! Think Fraud' Before Buying Concert Tickets
stories.summary: The Home Office is warning music and event fans to take precautions against ticket fraud, as part of an ongoing anti-fraud campaign targeting consumers buying tickets through unofficial channels.

stories.title: UK Launches Major Russia Sanctions Package in Continued Support of Ukraine
stories.summary: Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has unveiled his first major Russia sanctions package, targeting those behind the Kremlin's war effort and reinforcing the UK's commitment to supporting Ukraine until Russia ceases its aggression.

stories.title: Millions to Receive Benefit and Pension Payments Early Ahead of August Bank Holiday
stories.summary: DWP has announced that payments for Universal Credit, State Pension, PIP, and nine other benefits will be brought forward to 28 August to account for the bank holiday on 25 August, ensuring millions of recipients are not left without funds.

agencies.name: DEFRA
agencies.description: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs

stories.title: Air Quality Alert: Hot, Dry Weather Driving Up Pollution Levels Across UK
stories.summary: DEFRA's UK Air Quality Information service issued a bulletin on 13 August warning that persistent dry, hot and sunny weather has resulted in elevated pollution levels in several UK locations, urging vulnerable people to reduce outdoor activity.

stories.title: Bluetongue Virus Cases Confirmed in Devon Livestock
stories.summary: Cases of Bluetongue virus have been identified in ruminant animals across Devon, with Devon County Council sharing the latest guidance from DEFRA and the Animal Health Agency to help affected farmers.

stories.title: UK Defends Seizure of Russian Shadow Fleet Tanker After Putin Threat
stories.summary: The UK Ministry of Defence has defended its decision to seize a vessel from Russia's shadow fleet following threats from Putin. The MoD confirmed Russia operates over 700 shadow fleet vessels responsible for carrying 75% of the country's sanctioned oil exports.

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

stories.title: Unemployed Young People to Join Government AI Boot Camps
stories.summary: The UK government is launching AI boot camps targeting unemployed young people to help them develop skills for the modern workforce, as part of broader efforts to harness artificial intelligence for economic growth and employment.

stories.title: AI Transparency Record Published for Newcastle Council's Amazon Contact Centre Tools
stories.summary: A new algorithmic transparency record was published on 13 August 2026 for Newcastle City Council's use of Amazon Q and Contact Lens AI tools, fulfilling government requirements for public sector AI accountability.

stories.title: NHS Transplant Service Admits Data Breach Over Unencrypted Pager Network
stories.summary: An NHS transplant service has admitted that sensitive medical data of patients across the UK was routinely transmitted over an unencrypted pager network, raising serious data security and patient privacy concerns.

stories.title: Research Finds Digitised GP Surgeries Improve Medication Safety by 46%
stories.summary: A new study shows that digital interventions in primary care improve medication safety by 46% compared to traditional care, with digitised GP surgeries demonstrating significantly lower rates of high-risk prescribing.

stories.title: NHS Tayside Ordered to Release Withheld Information on Eljamel Case
stories.summary: NHS Tayside has been ruled to have 'fallen short' of its obligations after incorrectly withholding information in response to a 2023 Freedom of Information request related to the Eljamel neurosurgeon scandal, and has been ordered to release the data.

stories.title: Amazon Suspends Royal Mail Parcel Collect Returns Service in UK
stories.summary: Amazon has suspended its UK Royal Mail Parcel Collect Returns service, ending the doorstep collection option for Amazon returns via Royal Mail and impacting customers who relied on this convenient returns method.
